title: Advance-Payment Schedule: Amount Due for the Rest of the School Year
content:
**Clause.** For an advance payment of Pre-K tuition under Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, the advance payment is figured as follows.

1. **Open balance.** The open balance is the enrollment's tuition charges, late fees and refunds less its payments and credits.
2. **Months not yet posted.** The months not yet posted are the school year's 10 billing months less the tuition charges already posted on the enrollment.
3. **Amount.** The advance payment is the open balance, plus every month not yet posted priced at the most recent billing month's tuition charge, less the standard discount of 3 percent of those months at that charge. The most recent billing month is the latest billing month that carries a tuition charge.
4. **Nothing left to post.** When no month of the school year is left to post, nothing is taken off and the advance payment is the open balance.
5. **Order and rounding.** The schedule's amounts are applied in one order: first the months not yet posted are priced and added to the open balance; then amounts that take the place of the discount, then multipliers, then reductions of the discount, never taking it below zero; then the discount and the other reductions are taken off. Only that final amount is rounded to the nearest cent, half a cent rounding up.

## Worked example (hypothetical enrollment)

Six tuition charges are posted, the most recent month's tuition charge is 300.00 and the open balance is 150.00.

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Months not yet posted | 10 less 6, that is 4 |
| Those months at 300.00 | 1,200.00 |
| Open balance plus those months | 1,350.00 |
| Standard discount: 3 percent of 1,200.00 | 36.00 |
| Advance payment | 1,314.00 |

If all 10 tuition charges were already posted, the advance payment would be the open balance of 150.00, with nothing taken off.
